title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306 (part:360020), multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

thank you for your offer. You told us in June that only multi-year volume agreements change prices for standard items, so we propose exactly that. This gives you planned base load and less order handling. We would keep the 60-day payment term of the current agreement. The attached term sheets set out the details.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Which of these packages works best for you? Is there a cheaper variant you could offer?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306 (part:360020), multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposal for a 24-month agreement. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our offer provides a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. The package with 30-day payment terms works best for us, but the requested price reduction is not feasible. However, we can offer €4.88 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30 days net. We also have an alternative package offering a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 – revised 24-month packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

thank you for your revised offer and for sharing the cost-saving options. We have moved our proposal a clear step towards you. The attached term sheets cover 20000 pieces per year over 24 months. One package uses 90-day payment and the other 30-day payment, which supports your cash flow. A firm two-year commitment gives you planned volume and less order handling for a standard item.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

We will review the material-grade and tolerance options with our engineering team separately. Could you tell us whether a larger lot size per call-off would lower your handling effort further?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 – revised 24-month packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your requested prices, but we are unable to offer further reductions for these terms. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We offer a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
